name: Spherical Harmonic Volume Ray Casting
aliases: GPU-based volume ray-caster with SH coefficients
SH Volume Ray Casting with Hybrid CPU/GPU Projection
Spherical Harmonic (SH) Volume Ray Casting with Hybrid CPU/GPU Projection
definition: A technique for interactive volume rendering that approximates light-material interaction by pre-computing Spherical Harmonic (SH) coefficients for material and light functions on the CPU, storing them in 3D volumes, and evaluating the rendering integral via Monte-Carlo ray marching in a GPU fragment shader.
